mapper.select: WITH raw AS ( SELECT row_number() OVER () AS rn, id_hex, sku_id_hex, batch_no, secret_ciphertext, secret_nonce, secret_hash, secret_key_version, import_source, created_by_admin_username, created_by_admin_email, created_by_admin_phone FROM jsonb_to_recordset(CAST(#{itemsJson} AS jsonb)) AS item( id_hex text, sku_id_hex text, batch_no text, secret_ciphertext text, secret_nonce text, secret_hash text, secret_key_version text, import_source text, created_by_admin_username text, created_by_admin_email text, created_by_admin_phone text ) ), target_sku AS ( SELECT s.id, s.stock_quantity FROM product_sku s WHERE s.spu_id = #{spuId} AND s.id = #{skuId} FOR UPDATE ), inserted AS ( INSERT INTO card_secret_inventory ( id, sku_id, batch_no, secret_ciphertext, secret_nonce, secret_hash, secret_key_version, import_source, created_by_admin_username, created_by_admin_email, created_by_admin_phone, encrypt_algorithm, hash_algorithm, status, created_at, updated_at ) SELECT decode(id_hex, 'hex'), decode(sku_id_hex, 'hex'), batch_no, secret_ciphertext, secret_nonce, secret_hash, secret_key_version, import_source, created_by_admin_username, created_by_admin_email, created_by_admin_phone, 'AES_256_GCM', 'HMAC_SHA256', 'UNUSED', NOW(), NOW() FROM raw WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM target_sku) ORDER BY rn ON CONFLICT (secret_hash) DO NOTHING RETURNING id ), insert_summary AS ( SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS inserted_count FROM inserted ), updated_sku AS ( UPDATE product_sku s SET stock_quantity = s.stock_quantity + (SELECT inserted_count FROM insert_summary), updated_at = NOW() WHERE s.spu_id = #{spuId} AND s.id = #{skuId} AND (SELECT inserted_count FROM insert_summary) > 0 RETURNING s.stock_quantity ) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM raw)::int AS "requestedCount", EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM target_sku) AS "skuExists", (SELECT inserted_count FROM insert_summary)::int AS "insertedCount", COALESCE( (SELECT stock_quantity FROM updated_sku), (SELECT stock_quantity FROM target_sku), 0 )::int AS "skuStockQuantity"

SELECT to_base62(inventory.id) AS "cardSecretId", to_base62(inventory.sku_id) AS "skuId", sku.sku_name AS "skuName", inventory.status AS "inventoryStatus", delivery.status AS "deliveryStatus", COALESCE(delivery.order_no, inventory.order_no) AS "orderNo", orders.status AS "orderStatus", COALESCE(delivery.user_id, inventory.user_id) AS "userId", inventory.secret_ciphertext AS "secretCiphertext", inventory.secret_nonce AS "secretNonce", inventory.secret_key_version AS "secretKeyVersion" FROM card_secret_inventory inventory LEFT JOIN product_sku sku ON sku.id = inventory.sku_id LEFT JOIN order_card_secret_delivery delivery ON delivery.card_secret_id = inventory.id LEFT JOIN trade_order orders ON orders.order_no = COALESCE(delivery.order_no, inventory.order_no) WHERE inventory.id = #{cardSecretId}
